title: observation.v1
description: One SIGHTING of one ad on a list page of the EXAMPLE site. Append-only JSONL. Core floor (what the harness reads): schema, ad_id, site, seen_at, ad_url, list{url,page,page_count,position,sponsored,subcategory}, card, card_hash, bumped_at.

ad_url.description: The card's link to the ad page; what fetch-ads GETs. Added in the repo's first version because a sighting without it cannot drive a fetch.

crawl_id.description: Groups sightings from one crawl run (e.g. 2026-11-08T14:00Z/fe+ts/stratified-15).

page_count.description: Total pages at crawl time, so depth = page/page_count.

sample_weight.description: Inverse sampling fraction of this page's stratum (e.g. 530/36), for population estimates.

card.description: Volatile facts as the card shows them now. Site-specific names live under the site key.

example.description: The example site's own card facts.

bumped_at.description: When the list page shows one (some designs do not; then null).

card_hash.description: Hash of the card facts; a change from the last sighting triggers a listing refetch (fetch_reason card_changed).
